about.en: BLOCKLORDS is a player-driven medieval grand-strategy MMO in which players farm, fight, manage resources and rule territories as Heroes. LRDS is the game's economy and governance token, an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xd0a6053f087E87a25dC60701ba6E663b1a548E85 with a 100,000,000 supply, also deployed on Base at 0xB676f87A6E701f0DE8De5Ab91B56b66109766DB1.
